ai.model.doc: Choose the model. It reads handwriting, so it has to read images.

ai.provider.doc: Choose the LLM adapter. Its model goes back to config.toml's until `ai.model` sets one.

ai.remove_key.doc: Turn the Jev plugin off. The LLM's key can be replaced but not removed: nothing works without it.

ai.set_key.doc: Check a key with its provider, then save it. Turning Jev on is adding its key.

check.doc: Check now: in the background when a scheduler runs (the web server), else right here.

collect.doc: Read what changed in the watched documents now.

events.doc:
Changes after cursor `since` (without one: the last few), and the cursor to pass
next time. Every process's changes are here: the server's, the CLI's, an agent's.

items.edit.doc:
Change an item's text or status, or dismiss it (not an action; or delete one added here).
Returns the item, or {} once dismissed.

library.doc: Folders and documents for the watch picker, with what each watch would cover.

page.image.doc: A source page as SVG, with the line `anchor` highlighted.

pending.doc:
What the next collection would read: changed documents and, with `fetch`, their
changed pages (downloads only; nothing is read or judged).

todo.sync.doc: Read ticks and new items from the To-do document, then republish it if needed.

watch.from_now.doc:
Skip (on) or read again (off) what is already written in the documents at `path`
(a document, or every document in a folder now). Returns the settings, the documents
affected, and those already read in full, where there is nothing left to skip.
